Documentation=https://developer.hashicorp.com/vault/docs
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
User=vault
Group=vault
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/vault server -config=/etc/vault.d/vault.hcl
ExecReload=/bin/kill --signal HUP $MAINPID
KillSignal=SIGINT
LimitNOFILE=65536
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
VAULT_UNIT
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/vault.service; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now vault; systemctl is-enabled vault; for i in $(seq 1 45); do if curl --silent --show-error --cacert /etc/vault.d/tls/ca.crt "https://$NODE_IP:8200/v1/sys/health?standbyok=true&perfstandbyok=true&sealedcode=200&uninitcode=200" >/tmp/vault-health.json 2>/dev/null; then if python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open("/tmp/vault-health.json")); sys.exit(0 if d["initialized"] and not d["sealed"] else 1)'; then break; fi; fi; sleep 1; done; systemctl is-active vault; python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("/tmp/vault-health.json")); print("initialized=%s sealed=%s standby=%s version=%s"%(str(d["initialized"]).lower(),str(d["sealed"]).lower(),str(d["standby"]).lower(),d["version"]))'
